authority: This contract routes safe inventory intents only. It grants no mechanics, identity, ownership, custody, compatibility, quantity, destination, or mutation authority.

offerContract.sourceIdentity: opaque offer-local source selection plus a safe presentation row label; never a row, serialized-item, operation, profile, or provenance identity
offerContract.authority: authenticated role plus bounded server-issued checks; all must be satisfied for an enabled action
offerContract.revisions: source requirements are exact; every selected destination contributes its exact requirements
offerContract.quantity: none, one fixed value, a bounded current range, or the exact whole current stack
offerContract.destinations: none, optional, required from bounded current options, or server-determined
offerContract.consequences: safe labels state inventory, custody, mechanical, guided, and irreversible effects without private evidence
offerContract.navigation: inspect is app-relative navigation and cannot be submitted as a mutation

declarationContract.exactMatch: action, source, quantity, selected destination, irreversible confirmation, and the complete revision set must match one current offer
declarationContract.commitBoundary: matching an offer is not commit authorization; the owning handoff reloads every resource and revalidates all mechanics before mutation
declarationContract.replay: the owning journal supplies principal-bound command hashing, compare-and-swap settlement, terminal replay, and realtime publication

privacy.labels: container, section, source, destination, consequence, and unavailable labels must be bounded safe presentation text

failurePolicy: unknown action, source, destination, consequence, or handoff fails closed
unknown or missing fields fail closed
duplicate offer, destination, or revision identities fail closed
stale, missing, added, or changed revisions fail closed
disabled authority or destination options fail closed
whole-item and whole-stack quantities cannot be partially submitted
irreversible discard requires the exact server-issued confirmation
guided settlement cannot be replaced by freeform client mechanics
exact offer matching never bypasses authoritative commit-time revalidation
